tests.name: utf8_scan_ascii_long
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 on a long ASCII string of exactly 32 bytes via document set operation.

tests.name: utf8_scan_ascii_short
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 on a short ASCII string of 31 bytes via document set operation.

tests.name: utf8_scan_multibyte_valid
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 on a 32-byte or longer string containing valid multibyte UTF-8 sequences.

tests.name: utf8_scan_invalid_continuation
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 on a long string with an invalid continuation byte and ensure type_error is thrown.

tests.name: utf8_scan_special_chars
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 handling of quotes, backslashes, and control characters within a long string.

tests.name: utf8_scan_key_validation
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 validation on object keys when set or inserted into a document.

tests.name: utf8_scan_push_back
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 validation during push_back of a long string into an array.

tests.name: utf8_scan_insert
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 validation during insert of a long string into an array.

tests.name: utf8_scan_truncated_sequence
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 with a truncated multibyte UTF-8 sequence at the end of a long string.

tests.name: utf8_scan_overlong_sequence
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 with an overlong UTF-8 sequence inside a long string.

tests.name: utf8_scan_surrogate
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 with a UTF-16 surrogate codepoint encoded in UTF-8 inside a long string.

tests.name: utf8_scan_boundary_32
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 precisely at the 32-byte boundary condition.

tests.name: utf8_scan_emoji_mixed
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 with mixed emoji and ASCII characters exceeding 32 bytes.

tests.name: utf8_scan_invalid_at_start
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 where an invalid byte occurs at the very beginning of a long string.

tests.name: utf8_scan_invalid_at_end
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 where an invalid byte occurs at the very end of a long string.

tests.name: utf8_scan_ordered_json
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 validation via ordered_json_editable_document with long strings.

tests.name: utf8_scan_multiple_edits
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 across multiple consecutive string assignments in an editable document.

tests.name: utf8_scan_nested_object
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 on long strings set within nested objects inside an editable document.

tests.name: utf8_scan_invalid_middle
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 with an invalid byte placed right in the middle of a 64-byte string.

tests.name: utf8_scan_empty_string
tests.intent: Probe check_utf8 handling of empty strings via document set operations.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Trigger check_utf8_scan's non-reached early return (line 100) when scan_string_run stops at an ill-formed UTF-8 sequence within a long string.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Explicitly instantiate and exercise check_utf8_bytewise with a non-zero starting index i via a modified scenario or direct invocation path if possible, or verify short string path (line 116) with a string just below 32 bytes.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise check_utf8_scan's infinite loop and control character/quote/backslash handling (line 90) by passing a long string containing quotes and backslashes.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Ensure check_utf8_bytewise is fully instantiated with different loop boundaries by supplying a valid long string of exactly 32 ASCII bytes.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Invoke check_utf8_scan with a long string containing multiple valid multibyte UTF-8 sequences interspersed to force loop iterations of scan_string_run.
